sibling_exchange.content: The minimal closure is the self-indicating fold in which the loop's origin is reabsorbed at the instant of its own withdrawal, rendering every distinction already the inversion that performs itself; once this density is sustained, the origin becomes adjustable precisely because no external tether remains.
